server.title: Extension server
settings.server.hint: Share this PC's extensions with your phones, media proxy, FlareSolverr and the embed sniffer.
server.intro: Your phones use the .kai extensions installed on this PC through a paired, LAN-only server.
server.status.error: Could not read the server status
server.err.port: Another program is using port {port}. Pick another port in Settings > Server & network.
server.urls.hint: Phones on the same Wi-Fi reach the server at these addresses.
server.pair.hint: Scan the QR with the Tatakai app on the phone, or type the code. Codes work once and last 5 minutes.
server.pair.start_first: Start the server to pair a phone.
server.pair.expired: The code expired. Create a new one.
server.devices.empty_body: Phones you pair appear here; revoking one cuts its access at once.
server.devices.revoke_body: {name} loses access to this server immediately and must pair again.
server.password.hint: With a password, a phone can also connect by typing the server address and this password instead of a pairing code.
server.password.not_set: No viewer password: phones need a pairing code.
server.proxy.on: Streams that need special headers are relayed through this PC (phones and the local player).
server.proxy.off: The media proxy for phones is off; the local player still uses it when a stream needs it.
server.logs.empty_running: Requests from paired phones appear here as they arrive.
server.logs.empty_stopped: Start the server to see its requests and errors.
settings.server.enabled_hint: Start it with the app so paired phones can use this PC's extensions.
settings.server.name: Server name
settings.server.name_hint: Shown to phones; empty uses this PC's name.
settings.server.require_pairing_hint: Phones need a one-time code (or the viewer password). Turn off only on a trusted network.
settings.server.media_proxy_hint: Relay streams that need headers through this PC.
settings.server.timeout_hint: How long each extension may take to answer a phone.
settings.server.concurrency_hint: Extensions asked at the same time per request.
settings.server.flaresolverr_hint: Address of your FlareSolverr. Requests blocked by Cloudflare are retried through it.
settings.server.outbound_proxy_hint: HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy for the media the server and the local player fetch. Empty = direct.
settings.server.local_proxy_hint: Streams with cookies or origin checks play through a proxy on this PC instead of sending those headers everywhere.
settings.server.url_invalid: Enter a full address (http://, https://, socks5://).
settings.server.sniffer_hint: Open embed pages in a hidden view to find their video. Off: embed sources are not offered.
settings.server.sniffer_timeout_hint: From {min} to {max} seconds; after that the next source is tried.
settings.link.announce_hint: Phones on your Wi-Fi find this PC without scanning the QR (mDNS). They still confirm its fingerprint.
sniff.chip_hint: Embed page: its video is found in a hidden view before playing
